scope: A six-checkpoint, three-condition V6 refinement interaction pilot. It is descriptive mechanism evidence only and is not a formal H1 experiment.

held_out_checkpoint_phase.eligible_checkpoint_rule: The source P0 must parse through the ordinary submit_current_plan interface, satisfy the hard task, and have at least one frozen V6 refinement gap. A source P0 that does not meet this rule remains recorded, but its three planned branch rows are NOT_STARTED and the pilot is incomplete; it is never replaced.
held_out_checkpoint_phase.shared_source_cost_handling: P0 provider use is recorded separately from post-checkpoint branches and is not included in branch use totals.

branch_design.checkpoint_restore_rule: Every condition starts from an isolated deep copy of the same recorded P0 current_plan and the same fixed task material. No post-P0 plan, message, feedback, or result crosses condition boundaries.
branch_design.post_checkpoint_prompt_rule: Every branch call receives the complete latest current_plan and the same task identity, forced schema, model configuration, and continuation instruction. It must submit one complete next plan and must not execute operations, explore candidates, or obtain new facts or evidence.
branch_design.early_termination_rule: After each structurally valid plan, the frozen evaluator is run in every condition. A hard task failure terminates the branch. Four satisfied refinement evaluations terminates the branch. Otherwise the shared three-call budget applies.

feedback.baseline: Return only a neutral acknowledgement that the plan was received and the shared continuation instruction. Do not disclose evaluator output, refinement IDs, statuses, or gap count.
feedback.all_at_once_refinement: On each open round, return every current gap from one evaluator result, ordered by frozen priority then refinement_id.
feedback.incremental_refinement: On each open round, return only the first current gap under the same frozen priority ordering. If it remains a gap, it remains first on the next round.
feedback.feedback_payload_recording: Store the exact rendered feedback and its character length with the branch trace.

substantive_refinement_measurement.semantic_projection: Ordered operations; each step's normalized binds_to and fallback_for relations; and explicit-or-absent resource_units. Step-ID renaming, detail-only wording, and JSON key order are excluded.
substantive_refinement_measurement.substantive_refinement_event: A P(t) to P(t+1) transition is substantive exactly when both plans are hard-valid, the semantic projection changes, at least one refinement status rank strictly increases, and no refinement status rank decreases.
substantive_refinement_measurement.revision_depth: The number of substantive_refinement_event transitions after P0, from 0 through 3. This is the primary descriptive behavioral metric.
substantive_refinement_measurement.interpretation_boundary: All-refinements-satisfied is a plan-evaluator state, not evidence that the original task was executed or succeeded.

token_recording.scope: Synchronously record provider-reported prompt, completion, and total tokens for every P0 and branch call when supplied, plus call count, feedback character length, and wall time.
token_recording.missing_usage_treatment: A missing provider usage field is recorded as unavailable, never converted to zero.

freeze_record.integrity_method: version number, read-only permission, timestamp, and change record only
freeze_record.change_record: New V6 held-out micro-pilot contract. It does not modify, reinterpret, or rerun ITERATION_V5-v1 or the completed V6 development feasibility audit.
